compute_matching: PyTorch profiler training matmul FLOPs on batch 128; simple heads continue until D's 16-epoch estimated training FLOPs
gate_reference: frozen conventional local_gated route AND acceptance outputs from gate_results per seed
candidate_support: precomputed per-position choices; all ten digits at routed positions
C_definition: observed complete 1/2/4 residual reconstruction, including intermediate scale
B_definition: independently trained full-resolution 4-position VQ; never residual fine codes with missing coarse context
D_definition: unchanged learned 1/2/4 next-level predictor and ranker
selection: fixed budgets, validation-only per-variant temperature, no test checkpoint selection
